spans.s:
च्यु 1. च्यु, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) च्यवते,
-ति, चुच्युवे, च्योष्यते, अच्योष्ट, च्योतुम्,
to move to and fro, shake about, move, stir, move
from one's place, go away, retire from (with abl.);
to fly from (the hand or the bow-string, as a spear or
arrow); to fall off from, deviate from, abandon (duty
&c.); to be deprived of, lose (with abl., e. g. राज्याच्
च्यवते, he loses the kingdom); to fall away, fade
away, disappear, vanish, perish, wane, fail; to come
forth from, come out of, flow out, drop from, trickle,
stream forth from (in this sense cf. 2. च्युत्); to fall
down, fall, slip, slide; to sink down, sink (literally
and metaphorically); to decrease; to cause to move
or shake about; to bring about, create, make; to
cause to go away, to make forget: Caus. P. च्याव-
यति, (in the Pada-pāṭha च्यवयति), -यितुम्, to
cause to move, excite, agitate; A. to move one's self,
be shaken or moved; P. to loosen, to remove from
a place, drive away, expel from, remove; to deprive
a person of anything (with two acc., e. g. देवी न
च्यावयेद् राजानम् प्राणान्, let not the goddess
deprive the king of life); to cause to fall: Desid. of
Caus. चिच्यावयिषति and चुच्यावयिषति.

च्यु 2. च्यु [cf. च्युस्], cl. 10. P. च्यावयति,
यितुम्, to laugh; to suffer, bear (?); [cf.
Hib. tibhim, ‘I laugh, joke.’]

1. च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of compounds) shaking,
causing to fall, removing, destroying; dropping, dis-
tilling; [cf. अच्युत-च्युत्, ऋण-च्˚, धन्व-च्˚, &c.]

च्युत् 2. च्युत्, cl. 1. P. च्योतति, चुच्योत,
च्योतिष्यति, अच्युतत् and अच्योतीत्, च्योति-
तुम्, to drop, sprinkle, flow, trickle, ooze, exude; to
wet thoroughly, moisten; to fall down; to cause to
drop or stream forth; [cf. श्चुत्, श्च्युत्, and 1. च्यु
for 1. च्युत्; cf. also Hib. cioth, ‘a heavy shower;’
ciothmhar, ‘showery.’]

च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, shaken; deviated from,
erred, strayed; deprived; removed, expelled, ba-
nished; fallen from, fallen off, broken, disordered;
lost; fallen (e. g. नभश्-च्युत, fallen from the
sky), dropped, oozed out; (in Rāmāyaṇa

,
मधु-च्युत is probably a wrong form for मधु-
च्युत्.)
—च्युत-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a country.
—च्युत-पथक, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śākya-
muni.
—च्युताचार (˚त-आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, deviating
from duty.
—च्युताधिकार (˚त-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
dismissed from an office &c., deprived of a right.
—च्युतोत्साह (˚त-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
spent his energies, exhausted, incapable of effort.
च्यूत च्यूत, अस्, m. (for चूत), the anus.

च्युप च्युप, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1. च्यु),
the face, mouth.

च्युस् च्युस् [cf. 2. च्यु above], cl. 10. P.
च्योसयति, -यितुम्, to laugh; to bear; to
leave; to loose; to hurt, kill.
